meta.name: knowledge-agent
meta.description: Build and query AI-powered knowledge bases from claude-mem observations. Use when users want to create focused "brains" from their observation history, ask questions about past work patterns, or compile expertise on specific topics.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从对话历史构建可查询的知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望从日常对话中自动提炼知识并随时查询
copy.tagline_en: Build queryable knowledge bases from conversation history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to automatically extract knowledge from daily conversations and query it anytime

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会从你的 claude-mem 观察记录里按项目、类型、概念等条件筛出语料库,把它加载进一个 AI 会话,随后你就这个语料库提问,追问会保留上下文。
howto.when: 当你想从观察历史里建立聚焦的知识库、询问过去的工作模式,或汇总某个主题的经验时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 hooks 这个概念建一个知识库,名字叫 hooks-expertise
say.note: 会筛选观察记录生成语料库

say.text: 把 hooks-expertise 这个知识库加载起来
say.note: 建立 AI 会话并载入全部语料

say.text: 问它:5 个生命周期钩子分别在什么时候触发?
say.note: 从语料库作答,可继续追问

howto.what_en: After install, Claude filters your claude-mem observation history into a corpus by project, type, concepts and more, primes it into an AI session, then answers your questions about it with follow-up context kept.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to build a focused knowledge base from your observation history, ask about past work patterns, or compile expertise on a topic.

say_en.text: Build a knowledge base from the 'hooks' concept, name it hooks-expertise

say_en.note: Creates an AI session loaded with the corpus

say_en.text: Ask it: what are the 5 lifecycle hooks and when does each fire?
say_en.note: Answers from the corpus, follow-ups kept
